muxt generate def

flags:
--output-document
  shorthand: ""
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "make the template a full HTML document"
--output-file
  shorthand: ""
  type: string
  default: ""
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "the .gohtml file in the working directory to add the template to"
--output-fragment
  shorthand: ""
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "make the template an empty fragment (the default)"
--use-receiver-type
  shorthand: ""
  type: string
  default: ""
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "the receiver type to print a method stub for, when no muxt.json entry names it"

--help:
Add a route template to a template file.

Without --output-file it prints the template it would add and a method stub to paste, and changes nothing. With it, it writes the template file and prints the stub.

The stub is a placeholder to rewrite: it returns any and its body returns nil. Its receiver is a pointer when the type declares a pointer method, a value otherwise. Imports are not added.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/generate.md

Usage:
  muxt generate def NAME [flags]

Aliases:
  def, definition

Flags:
  -h, --help                       help for def
      --output-document            make the template a full HTML document
      --output-file string         the .gohtml file in the working directory to add the template to
      --output-fragment            make the template an empty fragment (the default)
      --use-receiver-type string   the receiver type to print a method stub for, when no muxt.json entry names it

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
